In 2026, the earth was rocked by more extreme weather and the moon seemed once again within our reach. The streets of our cities were rushed by celebrating sports fans and thronged with angry citizens. Technological change, with all the fear and excitement it brings, seemed to accelerate faster than ever. People reached for greatness —or, in a time of global conflict , simply for peace. We know all this because, despite everything that changes, we can still believe…
